title: Your neighbor wants a deposit
scenario: Someone in a neighborhood group offers a high-end stroller at a very good price. Their profile has local posts going back years, and they ask for a deposit because “three other people are interested.”

answers.A: Message through the platform and check whether the seller will provide a current photo with a specific detail you request.
answers.B: Send a small deposit because the long-standing local profile makes fraud unlikely.
answers.C: Arrange an in-person pickup/payment or use a marketplace payment method with buyer protection.

explanation: Established social accounts can be compromised. Transaction protections matter more than profile age.
proTip: Old profile, new seller: protect the transaction.
